en_title: BioShock Movie Director Francis Lawrence Explains Why It's Taken Hollywood So Long to Adapt the Game
cn_title: 《生化奇兵》导演谈电影改编难关
subtitle: 玩家主角如何搬上银幕
opus_summary: 《生化奇兵》电影导演Francis Lawrence谈及项目多年受阻的原因，包括预算、选角和创作分歧。他表示，将玩家主角搬上银幕仍是难题，但已接近找到办法。

paragraphs.en: We got the chance to sit down with Francis Lawrence, the director of Netflix’s BioShock movie, who gave us some of the gritty details as to why this adaptation has taken so long to make.
paragraphs.cn: 我们有机会采访了Netflix《生化奇兵》电影导演Francis Lawrence。他向我们透露了一些具体的幕后情况，解释这部改编电影为何迟迟未能拍成。

paragraphs.en: The BioShock movie is a project that’s been floating in limbo for more than a decade. The film initially had Gore Verbinski (Pirates of the Caribbean) attached to direct, but it fell through. Later, Guillermo del Toro was in talks to helm the steampunk movie, but that didn’t work out, either.
paragraphs.cn: 《生化奇兵》电影项目悬而未决已有十多年。最初，《加勒比海盗》导演Gore Verbinski曾计划执导，但最终未能成事。后来，吉尔莫·德尔·托罗也曾洽谈执导这部蒸汽朋克电影，同样没有结果。

paragraphs.en: Now, Lawrence — who directed almost every Hunger Games movie and, most recently, The Long Walk — is taking over. Lawrence chatted about his history with the BioShock movie in an interview for The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping , which comes to theaters next month. When asked about what projects he’d like to adapt in the future, he mentioned BioShock but admitted it’s been “tricky” to translate to the silver screen.
paragraphs.cn: 如今，项目由Lawrence接手。他执导了几乎所有《饥饿游戏》电影，最近的作品则是《漫长的行走》。在为下个月上映的《饥饿游戏：收获日出》接受采访时，Lawrence聊起了自己与《生化奇兵》电影的渊源。当我们问到他未来想改编哪些作品时，他提到了《生化奇兵》，但也承认，将这款游戏搬上大银幕一直很「棘手」。

paragraphs.en: “I'm also working on BioShock. That's another one that I've been really trying to get going, which is also at Netflix, which is partially tricky. That's a tricky adaptation, because it's an amazing, amazing world. But as a player, you are the lead character of that story. So cracking that is a tough one, but we're getting close, which is also exciting,” he told us.
paragraphs.cn: 他告诉我们：「我也在做《生化奇兵》。这也是我一直很努力想推动的项目，同样在Netflix，其中也有些棘手的地方。它很难改编，因为那个世界实在太精彩了。但玩游戏时，你就是故事的主角。所以，如何解决这一点是个难题，不过我们已经快找到办法了，这也很让人兴奋。」

paragraphs.en: Lawrence admitted the film has been in his orbit since 2009, saying that Verbinski actually approached him about it — essentially offering it up to him on a silver platter — after his vision for the movie was shot down by Universal.
paragraphs.cn: Lawrence坦言，自己从2009年起就与这部电影有了交集。他说，Verbinski的电影构想遭到环球影业否决后，曾主动找上他，几乎是直接把项目送到了他面前。

paragraphs.en: “This thing has kind of been on my radar for a long time, as was The Long Walk," he continued. "The Long Walk was something that I tried to do probably 20 years ago, and then somebody else got the rights, and then it kind of bounced around, bounced around, bounced around, and I sort of tracked it, and then it finally landed in my lap, and I went and made it. I remember BioShock was around 2009, I think Gore Verbinski was going to do it at Universal. But it was a $200 million movie, and he wanted a very specific person in it that was not a star, and it was R-rated. Universal was like, ‘No way are we doing this.’ So Gore actually approached me and asked if I wanted to do it, but I was already doing something else and couldn't.
paragraphs.cn: 他接着说：「我关注这个项目已经很久了，《漫长的行走》也是。大概20年前，我就想拍《漫长的行走》，后来别人拿到了版权，项目就这样辗转了好几手。我一直关注着，直到它终于到了我手上，我就把它拍了出来。我记得《生化奇兵》大概是2009年那会儿，我想当时Gore Verbinski准备在环球影业拍这部电影。但这是一部预算2亿美元(约合人民币13亿元)的电影，他又坚持要用某个并非明星的演员，而且电影还是R级。环球影业的态度就是，根本不可能拍这个。所以Gore真的来找我，问我想不想拍，但我当时已经在做别的项目，没法接。」

paragraphs.en: “So since probably 2009, it's kind of been in my orbit and something that's always been percolating a little bit like Long Walk. And then yeah, when Guillermo didn't see eye to eye with some of the — I think it was the creator of the game — and that kind of fell apart, then it came my direction. And so I sort of jumped at the opportunity and so I have been trying to develop that one.”
paragraphs.cn: 「所以，大概从2009年起，这个项目就一直与我有些交集，也一直在慢慢酝酿，和《漫长的行走》有点像。后来，Guillermo跟其中一些人意见不合——我想应该是游戏的创作者——项目就这么散了，随后又转到了我这边。我抓住了这个机会，此后一直在努力推进这部电影的开发。」

paragraphs.en: Lawrence’s remark about del Toro not seeing “eye to eye” with BioShock’s creator is a gentle way of putting their conversation; speaking with IGN earlier this year, del Toro told us that he never wants to try his hand at adapting a video game ever again, citing a “disastrous” phone call he had with the folks behind BioShock as the reason why.
paragraphs.cn: Lawrence用「意见不合」来形容德尔·托罗与《生化奇兵》创作者的交谈，已经是比较委婉的说法。今年早些时候接受IGN采访时，德尔·托罗告诉我们，他再也不想尝试改编电子游戏了，原因就是他与《生化奇兵》团队有过一次「灾难性」的通话。

paragraphs.en: “We had a very contentious call about a couple of games,” he recalled. “...So adapting it, BioShock, we had a couple of calls. They are probably one of the most disastrous calls I've ever had. So no, f**k no.”
paragraphs.cn: 他回忆道：「我们就几款游戏打过一次争执很激烈的电话。……说到改编《生化奇兵》，我们通过几次电话。那几次通话可能是我经历过最灾难性的通话之一。所以，不，他妈的绝不。」

paragraphs.en: Lawrence assured us that he's dedicated to making the movie the best it can be, telling us that he's focused on honoring the source material and making sure the game is faithfully brought to the screen as best it can be.
paragraphs.cn: Lawrence向我们保证，他会尽全力把这部电影拍好。他表示，自己着重于尊重原作，确保尽可能忠实地将游戏搬上银幕。

paragraphs.en: "The creator of BioShock had to basically just give the sign off on me, my knowledge," he said. "Again, [he] wanted to know that I was in love with the spirit of the game. I think he wanted to really protect certain elements and ideas and themes, as one should if you're the creator."
paragraphs.cn: 他说：「《生化奇兵》的创作者基本上得先认可我这个人，以及我对游戏的了解。还是那句话，他想确认我热爱这款游戏的精神内核。我想，他是想切实保护其中的某些元素、理念和主题，而身为创作者，本就应该这样。」

paragraphs.en: You can read more from our interview with Guillermo del Toro , and check out more news about Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping.
paragraphs.cn: 你可以阅读我们对吉尔莫·德尔·托罗的更多采访内容，也可以查看《饥饿游戏：收获日出》的更多消息。
